item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The intense winter monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will remain cold in the morning over the region. With upper-air disturbances departing from southern China today, the weather will improve over the region and it will be mainly fine in the following few days. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually in the latter part of this week. Temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise progressively, and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 23/02 (Wednesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.
Weather: Cold and cloudy with rain in the morning. Rain will ease off during the day. Sunny periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 9 - 14 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
